RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

Raising the panel’s gender without concrete evidence of bias is professionally counterproductive and unsupportable. In leadership roles like group head, business development, client management, and cultural fit often outweigh additional years of technical tenure; both candidates met the core chartered qualification. 

An all-female panel alone does not indicate discrimination, just as an all-male panel does not inherently imply bias. Alleging discrimination at this stage will damage your reputation and burn industry bridges. 

Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting constructive feedback on your interviews. Focus your inquiry strictly on how you can strengthen your commercial, strategic, and leadership profile for future executive opportunities.
